name: Granola #1
notes: You can fit 2 recipes in one sheet pan, although you may opt for a deeper pan so it’s easier to turn.

items: ¼ cup + 2 Tbsp dark brown sugar

steps.title: Mix dry ingredients
steps.body: Mix together **3 cups rolled oats**, **1 cup slivered or chopped almonds**, **1 cup cashews** and **¾ cup shredded sweet coconut**.

steps.title: Mix wet ingredients
steps.body: In another bowl, mix **¼ cup + 2 Tbsp dark brown sugar**, **¼ cup + 2 Tbsp maple syrup**, **¼ cup vegetable oil** and **¾ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Pour over dry ingredients and mix together. Pour into a sheet pan.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 300°F for about 75 minutes, stirring every 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Add the fruit
steps.body: Remove from oven and add **1 cup dried fruit**.
